system.description:
As a Reaction, you can negate a single ranged attack by making a Use the Force check. The DC of the check is equal to the result of the attack roll you wish to negate, and you take a -5 cumulative penalty for every time you have used this Talent, Block, Deflect, or Grenade Defense since the beginning of your last turn.

You must have a blaster drawn in order to use this Talent, and you must be aware of the attack and not be Flat-Footed. Using this Talent consumes one shot from the blaster for each attack you negate.
